question_text: Was Rockstar hacked in the GTA 6 Xbox build leak?
answer_text: Not established. A leaker says it has a near-complete Xbox build, and an outside group says the files look real, but Rockstar and Take-Two have not said the files are real or that they were breached, and how the leaker got them is unknown.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A Rockstar or Take-Two statement on the build or a breach, a court filing, or law enforcement naming how the build was taken.
Rockstar or Take-Two confirming the files, or a second independent examination reported by press.

question_text: Did the leaker really post the executable on Nov 23?
answer_text: Reported. Five outlets say the leaker posted the executable on Nov 23, relaying its own posts. One outside researcher's analysis, relayed by one outlet, says it looks like a real Xbox build; Rockstar and Take-Two have not commented.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A second outlet reporting the drop, or Rockstar or Take-Two taking it down and saying so.

question_text: How did the leaker get the build, and who is behind it?
what_would_settle_it: A company or law enforcement statement, or a court filing naming a method or a person.
